awareness.name: Unaware
awareness.text: Busy with its work. Does not activate or react. Becomes Alerted when its element sees a player model, hears noise, is hit, or the alarm is raised.

awareness.name: Alerted
awareness.text: Knows something is wrong but has no target in sight. Activates using its profile's No target list, toward the marker.

awareness.name: Engaged
awareness.text: Any Alerted model that can see a standing player model when it activates or reacts. Uses its profile's Target in sight list.

awareness.name: At the start
awareness.text: Elements start Unaware unless the mission says otherwise. Automated models, and models the mission places on Overwatch, start Alerted.

marker: Place or move the marker to the source of the latest noise, or to where an enemy model last saw a player model.
An Alerted model that ends a Move within 3" of the marker, seeing no player model, removes it. Its element then holds where it is.
With no marker on the board, Alerted models hold: stay in cover facing the nearest door and go on Overwatch.
alarm: When an element first sees a player model or is hit, it raises the alarm at the end of its next activation: every element on the board becomes Alerted, and the alert track rises by 1.
If every model of the element is Down, Dead or has surrendered before then, the alarm is not raised.

noise.name: Quiet
noise.sources: Moving, opening and closing doors, hacking, close combat, Silenced shots, smoke grenades

noise.name: Loud
noise.sources: Unsilenced shooting, forcing a door with a breaching tool
noise.heard: Elements with a model within 12", measured through walls

noise.name: Very loud
noise.sources: Frag grenades, flashbangs, breaching charges, any explosion

drills.name: No drill
drills.text: Each model follows its lists alone. Shoots instead of Aiming, never cracks doors, and throws grenades only where its list says.

drills.name: Fire and manoeuvre
drills.text: A model ends a Move in the open, in sight of a player model, only while a friend of its element covers it: on Overwatch, or Engaged with the same target. Otherwise it stops in the last cover on its route, or goes on Overwatch instead of moving. Charges are exempt.

drills.name: Bounding and grenades
drills.text: As Regular, and: throws a frag at 2 or more player models within its blast radius, with no friend in it; at a closed door with the marker or a seen player model beyond, cracks and throws (flashbang first, else frag); the last model of the element to activate each round goes on Overwatch if it has no target.

drills.name: Assault drill
drills.text: As Veteran, and: focus fire, shooting the player model its element has already hit this round if it can see it; picks Leaders and Auto gunners first at each step of the target list.

activation_order: A Leader with a friend within 6" that has 2 or more Suppression.
Other Engaged models, most Suppression first.
Alerted models, nearest the marker first.
targets: Ignore Down, Dead and surrendered models unless nothing else is in sight.
A player model it can hit without a cover penalty, nearest first.
Otherwise the player model in the least cover, nearest first.
Auto weapons spread to every other player model they can engage.
moving: To cover: the nearest position in cover within the Move, Heavy before Light. If the line says "with a target", it must still see one; otherwise it ends out of sight of every player model if it can.
Toward the marker or a target: by the shortest route through doors, ending in cover if it can. Enemy models open locked doors on their own vessel with an Interact.
Away: by the shortest route out of sight of every player model, ending in cover.
close_quarters: Used first by an Engaged model with a player model within 6", unless its profile says otherwise. Read top-down.
Outnumbered (more standing player models than friends within 6" of it) and not Aggressive: Move away, then Shoot if it still has a target.
Fight 2 or more, a target within its Move, and Aggressive or Tactical: charge it (close combat).
Two or more player models within a frag's blast radius of one point, no friend in it, and it carries frag: Throw it, then Move to cover.
Otherwise: use its profile's Target in sight list.
surrender: A model whose profile allows it tests when it activates Pinned or Wounded with a player model within 6" in its line of sight: 2d6 + Nerve, 8+, or it surrenders.
A surrendered model lies down, takes no actions, cannot react and is not a target. It is a prisoner if the mission allows it.
tie_breakers: The option nearest the enemy's objective, or the marker if there is no objective.
The lowest-numbered enemy model, or the player model nearest the enemy's objective.

behaviors.name: Cowed
behaviors.summary: Holds its compartment, falls back under Suppression, may surrender.
behaviors.investigate: None. Cowed models never move toward the marker.
engaged: Pinned or Wounded, with a player model within 6" in sight: test to surrender, then carry on down the list if it passes.
In the open: Move to cover, then Move away.
Otherwise: Shoot, Shoot.
alerted: If it can see a door toward the marker: Move away, out of sight of that door.
reactions: Unactivated: when shot at in the open, Move to cover.

behaviors.name: Sentry
behaviors.summary: Holds chokepoints, overwatches doors, raises the alarm.
behaviors.investigate: One model: the lowest-numbered model without an Auto weapon. The rest hold.
engaged: In the open: Move to cover with a target, then Shoot.
Auto weapon with two or more targets in sight: Suppressive Fire, then Shoot.
A target within short range: Aim, then Shoot.
Otherwise: Shoot, then Overwatch.
alerted: The investigator: Move toward the marker, twice.
Already in cover covering the door of its compartment nearest the marker: Overwatch.
Others: Move to cover covering that door, then Overwatch.
reactions: Overwatch: Shoot at the first trigger it can.
Unactivated: when shot at in the open, Move to cover.
behaviors.close_combat: Breaks after a lost exchange if Wounded or with 2 or more Suppression.

behaviors.name: Aggressive
behaviors.summary: Closes distance, flanks through side passages, seeks close combat.
engaged: Fight 2 or more and a target within its Move: charge it.
A target within short range: Shoot, Shoot.
Otherwise: Move toward the nearest target, then Shoot.
alerted: Move toward the marker, twice. Prefer a route that does not pass through a door a player model can see.
reactions: Overwatch: Shoot at the first trigger it can.
Unactivated: when a player model comes within short range in its sight, Shoot.
behaviors.close_combat: Never breaks while it has fewer than 3 Suppression.

behaviors.name: Tactical
behaviors.summary: Fire and manoeuvre: one element fixes while another moves; uses Overwatch and grenades.
behaviors.investigate: Every model, in bounds: the first model to activate Moves, the next covers it from Overwatch, alternating.
engaged: In the open: Move to cover with a target, then Shoot.
No friend of its element is covering the target: Shoot, then Overwatch.
A friend is covering and the target is beyond short range: Move to cover closer to the target, out of its line of sight on the way if it can, then Shoot.
Otherwise: Aim, then Shoot.
alerted: First of its element this round: Move toward the marker, then Overwatch.
Otherwise: Move to cover covering the friend ahead, then Overwatch.
reactions: Overwatch: Shoot at the first trigger it can.
Unactivated: when shot at in the open, Move to cover; when a player model comes within short range in its sight, Shoot.
behaviors.close_combat: Breaks after a lost exchange if Wounded or with 2 or more Suppression.

behaviors.name: Saboteur
behaviors.summary: Avoids fights; works consoles, rigs charges, seals doors, destroys evidence.
behaviors.investigate: None. Saboteurs work their task and seal doors.
engaged: Pinned or Wounded, with a player model within 6" in sight: test to surrender, then carry on down the list if it passes.
Within 1" of its task: Interact (the mission says what each Interact achieves), then Interact again.
In the open: Move away, then Throw smoke between itself and the target if it has one.
Otherwise: Shoot, then Move away.
alerted: An open door between it and the marker within its Move: Move to it, close it and lock it (Interact).
Otherwise: Move to its task and Interact.
reactions: Unactivated: when shot at, Move away.

behaviors.name: Automated
behaviors.summary: Permanent Overwatch on its field of fire, or triggers on proximity.
engaged: Drone with no target within short range: Move to within short range with a target, then Shoot.
Otherwise: Shoot, then Overwatch. A turret only shoots into the field of fire the mission gives it.
alerted: Drone: Move toward the marker, then Overwatch.
reactions: Overwatch: Shoot at every trigger it can, up to two.
Never Unaware: it does not hear noise, and starts on Overwatch.
behaviors.close_combat: Never breaks; it has no melee weapon, so it loses every exchange it is forced into.

behaviors.name: Leader
behaviors.summary: Rallies the most suppressed friend nearby, then acts with its element.
behaviors.investigate: Goes with the nearest element; raises its drill one step while within 6".
engaged: A friend within 6" with 2 or more Suppression: Rally the most suppressed, then take one action from the line below.
Otherwise act as the profile of the nearest friendly element (Sentry if it is alone).
alerted: A friend within 6" with 2 or more Suppression: Rally it.
Otherwise act as the profile of the nearest friendly element (Sentry if it is alone).
behaviors.close_combat: Breaks after a lost exchange if Wounded.

behaviors.name: Handler
behaviors.summary: Independent elite; protects the patron's interests first, the mission second.
behaviors.investigate: Moves to the patron's asset, never toward the marker.
engaged: A player model within 6" of the patron's asset: Shoot it, Shoot it (or charge it, if within its Move).
Wounded or with 2 or more Suppression, and the asset safe or lost: Move away, toward the nearest exit. It escapes if it leaves the board.
Otherwise: Aim, then Shoot, picking Leaders first.
alerted: Move toward the patron's asset; within 3" of it, Overwatch.
reactions: Overwatch: Shoot at the first trigger it can.
Unactivated: when a player model comes within short range in its sight, Shoot.
behaviors.close_combat: Breaks after a lost exchange if Wounded.

behaviors.name: Attached
behaviors.summary: Uses the profile of the element it is attached to.
behaviors.investigate: As the element it is attached to.
engaged: Act as the profile of the element it is attached to (Tactical if it is alone).
alerted: Act as the profile of the element it is attached to (Tactical if it is alone).
reactions: As the element it is attached to.
behaviors.close_combat: As the element it is attached to.

ranks.name: Green
ranks.text: New to the job: crew, conscripts, fresh hires.

ranks.name: Regular
ranks.text: Trained and steady: most soldiers and professional security.

ranks.name: Veteran
ranks.text: Experienced: team leaders, specialists, seasoned contractors.

ranks.name: Elite
ranks.text: The best there is: special operators, intelligence handlers.

shoot_scale.text: Professionals: rangers, Task Force Boone, top-tier contractors.
Elite units: Raid Force Alpha, Delta Force.

attributes.name: Move
attributes.text: Inches per Move action (usually 5-7). Training, exoskeletons and heavy kit all show here.

attributes.name: Shoot
attributes.text: Hit rolls, Suppressive Fire and reaction shots.

attributes.name: Physique
attributes.text: Throwing, forcing doors with a breaching tool, holding on in decompression, getting up when Down.

attributes.name: Nerve
attributes.text: Breaking tests, Find Cover, and initiative for Leaders.

attributes.name: Tech
attributes.text: Medic actions, hacking, putting out fires and other technical work.

attributes.name: Wounds
attributes.text: Wounded markers a model can carry; one more puts it Down.

attributes.name: Size
attributes.text: Physical bulk: 1 small drone, 2 human, 3 large (walkers and vehicles are larger). Used by rules for hatches, cover and vehicles.

hit_modifiers.text: Target in darkness beyond 6" (no low-light gear)

wound_table.text: Wounded: add a Wounded marker. More markers than Wounds: Down
Wounded and +1 Suppression. More markers than Wounds: Down
Down: may recover (end-of-round test 8+, or Medic)
Down and bleeding: dies at end of third round unless Medic 8+
Critical: dies at end of next round unless Medic 10+

factions.name: Task Force Boone
factions.summary: Expeditionary task force whose Void Assault Teams board and clear ships and stations.

factions.name: Freespace Solutions
factions.summary: Privatized debt and salvage corporation that unofficially conducts grey-zone operations for paying patrons.

factions.name: Contractors
factions.summary: Mercenary companies and hired guns Freespace pays by the job.

factions.name: Meridian Directorate
factions.summary: Technocratic state run through its intelligence ministries; Freespace's current patron.

threat_tiers.name: Low
threat_tiers.summary: Crew and asset security under a recovery captain.

threat_tiers.name: Medium
threat_tiers.summary: Adds collections enforcers, salvage techs and automated defences.

threat_tiers.name: High
threat_tiers.summary: Adds repossession teams, liquidators and hired guns; a contractor reaction force answers high alert.

threat_tiers.name: Story
threat_tiers.summary: Adds Meridian Directorate handlers or deniable operators.

gear.name: Breaching charge
gear.text: One charge. Place with Interact on a door, hatch or thin bulkhead within 1"; detonate later as an action (chapter 6).

gear.name: Breaching tool
gear.text: Force a locked door: Interact, 2d6 + Physique, 8+ (chapter 3). Also counts as a breaching tool or heavy blade in close combat.

gear.name: Trauma kit
gear.text: The carrier has the Medic skill.

gear.name: Hacking rig
gear.text: The carrier may Hack locked doors and consoles: Interact, 2d6 + Tech against the security level (chapter 3). Quiet.

gear.name: Low-light optics
gear.text: The carrier has the Low-light skill: it ignores the darkness penalty.

gear.name: Extinguisher
gear.text: May Interact with a fire cell in contact: 2d6 + Tech, 8+ to put it out (chapter 8).

gear.name: Silencer
gear.text: The carrier's ranged weapon gains the Silenced keyword: its shots are not noise for the alert track.

gear.name: Jump pack
gear.text: Move ignores the extra cost of obstacles and may cross gaps up to half the model's Move. In zero-g, the model may change direction freely during a Move and stop anywhere, even away from a surface (it still counts as unbraced).

gear.name: Jammer
gear.text: Enemy Automated models within 6" take -2 to hit, and enemy Hack tests within 6" take -2.

weapon.name: Auto
weapon.text: Auto N: may use Suppressive Fire. Shoot or Suppressive Fire may engage up to N models within 3" of the first target, one roll each, -1 after the first.

weapon.name: One per round
weapon.text: May fire once per round, including reactions.

weapon.name: Cumbersome
weapon.text: An extra -1 when firing after a Move; cannot fire as a reaction.

weapon.name: Blast
weapon.text: Affects every model within the blast radius with line of sight to the point of impact.

weapon.name: Confined
weapon.text: +1 wound row to models in an enclosed compartment of 6" x 6" or smaller.

weapon.name: Breach
weapon.text: Can destroy doors, hatches and thin bulkheads.

weapon.name: Silenced
weapon.text: Shots do not count as noise for the alert track.

armour.name: Sealed
armour.text: Protected from vacuum and smoke; resists decompression tests (+2).

armour.name: Heavy
armour.text: Bulky armour. Its weight is already reflected in the wearer's Move.

spine_turn.text: Turn left or right, toward the side with more open board (your choice if equal).

passage_branch.text: A compartment on one side (the side with more open board; your choice if equal).
A compartment on one side and a small room on the other.

junction_branch.text: A small room on one open side.
A side passage (one passage tile) off one open side, ending in a compartment.

loop_door.text: A second door into the other tile. Second doors make loops: more than one way round.

door_state.text: Locked, at the room's security level.

cover.label: Container
cover.piece: A shipping container or crate stack taller than a model.

cover.label: Salvage
cover.piece: A large piece of wreckage or a dismantled engine.

cover.label: Scrap
cover.piece: A pile of scrap, plating or barrels.

cover.label: Scrap
cover.piece: A pile of scrap, plating or barrels.

cover.label: Machine
cover.piece: A heavy machine: lathe, press or fabricator.

cover.label: Reactor housing
cover.piece: A reactor, drive housing or large machinery block.

cover.label: Beds
cover.piece: Medical beds or a treatment station.

cover.label: Equipment
cover.piece: A large piece of lab equipment.

rooms.name: Maintenance access
rooms.text: A crawlway hatch leads off the deck: Size 2 or less only. Missions may use it as a second way in or out.

rooms.name: Escape pod
rooms.text: Enemy models may flee by it: a model that ends its activation here leaves the board.

rooms.name: Secondary airlock
rooms.text: A second way in or out for either side; mission reinforcements may arrive here.

vessels.name: Freighter / ore hauler
vessels.text: Long and plain: a spine of passages with holds off both sides.

vessels.name: Salvage tender
vessels.text: Freespace's own working ships: cluttered bays and workshops, cheap locks.

vessels.name: Corvette / patrol craft
vessels.text: A small warship: tight passages and hard locks.

vessels.name: Station module
vessels.text: A mining or research station section: junction-heavy, with many small rooms. Add 1 to junction branch rolls.

hazards.name: Darkness
hazards.text: Power failure: the whole deck is in darkness (chapter 8).

hazards.name: Zero-g
hazards.text: Gravity is off on the whole deck (chapter 8).

hazards.name: Fire
hazards.text: Place a fire marker in the middle of one compartment: the workshop, salvage bay or life support if there is one, otherwise the one nearest the heart (chapter 8).

hazards.name: Hull breach risk
hazards.text: Every outer wall is hull: a breaching charge or frag that damages it causes decompression (chapter 8).

teams.name: Void Assault Team (VAT) fireteam
teams.summary: The boarding fireteam: assault, a close-quarters gunner, and a data specialist.

teams.name: Pathfinder recon team
teams.summary: Recon and fire support with armour-piercing heavy rifles and a SAW.

teams.name: Control team
teams.summary: Two marksmen who hold overwatch over long passages, hangars and open decks.

starting_forces.name: Boarding element
starting_forces.summary: One VAT fireteam plus one attached specialist: 6 models.
recommended_gear: One VAT Assaulter carries a breaching charge, the other a trauma kit.
Attach a Pathfinder with a trauma kit if you expect long fights; a Marksman for ships with hangars or long passages.

skills.name: Leader
levels: A Rally made by a Leader, or on a model within 6" and in line of sight of a Leader, removes 2 Suppression instead of 1. At initiative, each side adds the Nerve of its Leader with the highest Nerve.

skills.name: Void-trained
levels: Ignores the unbraced zero-g penalty; may push off and stop at any surface.

skills.name: Medic
levels: +2 to Medic actions; automatically gets a Down model back up.

skills.name: Automated
levels: Never gains Suppression, never tests for breaking, and is not affected by casualty shock or Rally. A wound row of 6 or more destroys it. Attributes shown as a dash are never used.

skills.name: Marksman
levels: An Aimed shot also ignores the Light cover penalty.

thrown.name: Flashbang
thrown.effect: +2 Suppression; removes Overwatch; cannot react until end of round

thrown.name: Smoke grenade
thrown.effect: Blocks line of sight through the area until end of next round

demolitions.name: Breaching charge
demolitions.effect: Destroys a door, hatch or thin bulkhead; models within 2" on the far side gain 2 Suppression; models within 1" take 2d6 damage
